title: Chip Industry Technical Paper Roundup: Nov. 17
gist: A thin weekly listing of seven new academic semiconductor papers (titles and institutions only, no findings): HBM4 controller partitioning onto the HBM base die (UC Riverside), 2D CFETs with single-crystal high-k dielectrics, 5G-based hardware location checks against AI-chip smuggling (Texas A&M), ECC embedded in neural-network weights against bit-flip attacks, e-beam contact optimization, sub-volt HZO ferroelectric DRAM-class capacitors, and randomized-cache hardware security.

insights.claim: UC Riverside researchers propose partitioning HBM memory-controller functions between the host processor and the HBM base die, moving control logic closer to memory rather than keeping it entirely host-side.
insights.speaker: Linda Christensen
insights.so_what: Logic-on-base-die for HBM4 raises the value of the base die (often made on foundry logic processes) and is worth watching for memory makers and foundries supplying base dies.
insights.quote: Beyond Host-Side Control: HBM Controller Partitioning Across Host and HBM Base Dies

insights.claim: A Seoul National University, Hanyang University and POSTECH paper claims to resolve the Kay-Dunn limit and the speed-endurance dilemma in ferroelectric Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 (HZO), targeting DRAM-class sub-volt capacitors.
insights.speaker: Linda Christensen
insights.so_what: Sub-volt ferroelectric HZO capacitors are a candidate path for lower-power DRAM scaling; early-stage academic signal for memory roadmaps.
insights.quote: Resolving the Kay–Dunn limit and the speed–endurance dilemma in ferroelectric Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 for DRAM-class sub-volt capacitors

themes.theme: AI-chip export control and hardware security

insights.claim: Texas A&M University researchers propose '5G CATS', a 5G-based cryptographic authorization scheme that performs hardware-based location checks to counter trafficking and smuggling of AI chips.
insights.speaker: Linda Christensen
insights.so_what: Hardware location-verification for AI accelerators is an emerging policy-tech lever for export-control enforcement; relevant to US-China chip restrictions and GPU vendors.
insights.quote: 5G CATS: 5G-Based Cryptographic Authorization Against Trafficking of Semiconductor Devices

insights.claim: University of Florida researchers propose SANAI, which embeds distributed keyed ECC parity directly in neural-network weights to protect models against hardware bit-flip attacks.
insights.speaker: Linda Christensen
insights.so_what: AI model integrity at the hardware level is becoming a research focus; points to future demand for weight-protection features in AI accelerators and memory.
insights.quote: SANAI: Secure ECC Distributed Keyed Parity Embedded in Weights for Protecting Neural Networks against Bit-Flip Attacks

insights.claim: Ruhr University Bochum, the Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy and Georgia Tech survey the challenges and trade-offs of implementing randomized caches in hardware as a defense against cache side-channel attacks.
insights.speaker: Linda Christensen
entities: Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy
insights.so_what: Randomized caches trade performance/area for side-channel resistance; a watch item for CPU security architecture.
insights.quote: Randomized Caches in Hardware: Challenges and Trade-offs

insights.claim: Researchers from the National University of Singapore, Nexstrom and UNSW demonstrate low-power 2D complementary FETs (CFETs) built with single-crystal high-k dielectrics.
insights.speaker: Linda Christensen
insights.so_what: 2D-material CFETs are a long-horizon post-GAA scaling path; startup Nexstrom's involvement is a name to track.
insights.quote: Low-power 2D CFETs using single-crystal high-κ dielectrics

insights.claim: RWTH Aachen University reports that optimized electron-beam evaporation can mitigate the degradation of metal-semiconductor contacts.
insights.speaker: Linda Christensen
insights.so_what: Contact resistance/degradation is a key bottleneck for advanced and 2D devices; process tweaks here matter to deposition-tool suppliers.
insights.quote: Mitigating the degradation of metal–semiconductor contacts with optimized electron beam evaporation
